contracts.asserts: Gesture/contact generations, hold/cancel and balanced releases, release-callback reset, route-shared button disposition and pending-frame lifetime Original unmatched BTN_0..BTN_15 up passthrough, zero/negative polarity, independent-stream pair state; BTN_TOUCH remains internal.

kernel_contracts.asserts: Six real-workqueue scenarios: two-stream delayed holds and ordered releases, overdue release cancellation, pending/escaped-hold settings disable, and pending/escaped-hold layer changes; exact KSCAN edges and raw timestamps

limits: Six real-kernel scenarios cover queued hold cancellation and balanced KSCAN callbacks; downstream KSCAN queue, physical HID/split delivery and exhaustive interleavings remain separate.

execution.default: quick: every behavioral fixture and scenario under ASan/UBSan once
execution.full: ZMK_TEST_MODE=full: same scenarios plus optimized, coverage and existing 32-bit variants
execution.integration: owner native/DTS/API guards when interfaces or kernel contracts change; not a prerequisite for pure host behavior
execution.transport: actual ordered USB/BLE/split/power/reset evidence; archived simulation is not a passing substitute

fixtures.asserts: Actual full runtime entry rejects empty, unrelated and partially measured coverage; normal full runs retain measured lines/branches for every real function

Exact supported core/dependency pins, clean sources, missing inputs, nonoverlapping project paths separate from west/config metadata, fresh outputs outside source/dependency trees including aliases, parseable wrong-archive rejection; identity/digest bypass controls
Existing directories, directory symlinks and dangling symlinks preserve prior evidence and invoke no west command
Read-only actual IQS checkout and required mode cross Docker; missing/invalid producer rejects before Docker/west, existing/symlink outputs preserve evidence and child failures propagate.

infrastructure.preparation: Explicit pinned offline workspace; local unchanged ZMK clone and original fixture manifest; no fetch or source repair
infrastructure.limits: Admission tests control dependency responses. Actual native/API/firmware fixtures separately verify unchanged stock ZMK and DYA. Physical transport remains separate.

ownership.asserts: 45 real-kernel Matrix scenarios, three identical-binary runs each: output-wide claims, overlap, independent processors/streams, actual HID state, reset/layer/reentry/concurrent callbacks; paired suppression, repeats, negative values and touch aliases across retained/departed routes; pending-frame sync across KEY/ABS suppression and settings/layer resets. Fixtures: scan.c and lifecycle_cases.h.
ownership.host_capacity: kscan_harness: atomic claim/queue refusal, reserved final releases, duplicate/orphan/invalid claims, disabled output, reentry and recovery; driver_harness: rejected hold/tap and successful subsequent hold; exact edge values/order with a 35-edge non-power-of-two FIFO through wraparound
ownership.observations: Required release/recovery assertions execute after all OFFs. Original duration/independence checks and synthetic ON/ON/OFF outside Matrix remain a separate strict selection with normal expected-PASS assertions and nonzero failure exits; no accepted negative observations. Debug observation: a runtime-disabled route reentry may lose its first ON due to an unobserved prior OFF; the completed pair resynchronizes and a following fresh pair succeeds. Strict mode detects that loss.
ownership.negative_control: inactive-matrix.overlay removes Matrix and must fail matrix-key-isolation by name. iqs-inline-first calls the real producer inline and must fail both before-ON cases by name. Three repeats per core. Empty legacy selector removed after source/failure archival; its two assertions remain normal regressions. iqs-drop-release omits delivery of the actual OFF and must fail the final held-button assertion3/3.

iqs_producer.asserts: 17 cases use unchanged complete IQS source: private-queue first ON,20ms source edges, double/triple, replacement, routes before/after ON, all OFF work, final release/recovery and ordered traces. Strict mode preserves exact overlap ownership/duration assertion.
iqs_producer.selection: 45 Matrix +17 IQS =62. No explicit producer means IQS NOT RUN.
iqs_producer.limits: Gesture-to-click handoff; no full sensor frames/I2C/RDY/production abs2rel/PM retries/separate peripheral queues/split/physical host delivery.

ownership.acceptance: Balanced source ON/OFF pairs complete; final mouse buttons/virtual keys release and a fresh pointer click works. Early release across routes is permitted and logged.
ownership.normal_route_sequence: route-forwarded-pairs: complete ON/OFF pairs across route changes and recovery. Original route-forwarded-repeat preserved in strict selection.

efficiency.asserts: Same canonical conformance before/current; identical callback/checksum results; source identities; raw alternating repeats, CPU and lock counts
efficiency.limits: Host stand-ins and 4-claim/8-edge fixture; no Cortex-M, real-lock, input-latency or power verdict
